_comment: Scenario presets (per-year rates compound from the base year). Population follows CA DOF P-2A county projections when use_dof_population is true; population_growth is the fallback. Calibrate the total against the CEC 2025 IEPR by adding "calibration_csv" (see scenarios.py). data_center_mw: new data-center peak load by 5-digit county FIPS, flat at peak x data_center_load_factor; data_center_flexible_share of it shifts off the peak (carbon-aware). The website's what-if sliders start from these presets.

low.note: Slow electrification, efficiency keeps pace, no new data centers

mid.note: Steady EV/heat-pump adoption; a 1 GW AI campus in Kern (the Griddy demo site) and 500 MW in Santa Clara

high.note: Fast electrification and an AI data-center build-out in Kern, Santa Clara, Fresno and Imperial
